rule: Fill-path only, mapped by sheet geometry: each join targets the fillable cell whose printed caption (from the frozen page text layer) sits directly left of or just above it. Booleans take xbox_joins: the box immediately left of the printed option. Item 1 date takes three combs. Part III items 16-24 are one 14-slot comb per line with no centavo comb beside it, so they are plain joins. Part IV rows 25-28 are 33-slot combs spanning all columns, so those row keys stay blank. Schedule 1: the 25 printed product rows carry ATC codes XP010 to XP220 that match the layout ATC1-25 defaults, so each row maps its ten fillable cells (Place of Removal through Basic Excise Tax Due) by column caption; the two Others rows (26, 27) take description, unit, rate and the ten amount cells. The printed description, unit and rate of the product rows, and the ATC cells, have no fillable cells and stay blank. Item 8 contact and item 9 email share one 40-slot comb, and each of items 10 and 11 has one 40-slot comb for its region, province and city codes; each comb takes one derived print-map line (to_print_field_map) with the values placed under their own captions. Since #113: the page 2 header comb prints the TIN then the name (derived:page_header) and the Others ATC boxes print; every other value has a box or a reviewed not_joined reason.
